title: Lost Knowledge
description: Three Archmages before me have wanted the Amulet of Arcane Sight out of Willow Dale. Someone outside the Circle has started asking after that ruin, and I will not be the fourth. Go and take it first.

objectives.description: Get through the traps to the inner sanctum
objectives.notes: Use Detect Magic to reveal trap triggers

objectives.description: Put down the three arcane guardians
Take the Amulet of Arcane Sight

notes: Threat: an unnamed outside party asking after the same ruin, racing the Circle for it. Giver motive: three Archmages before Elara have failed to bring this amulet home, and losing it to an outsider now would be her failure specifically, in front of a council that remembers the other three. Consequence: unwired - there is no rival encounter in the data, so the race is stated in prose only. Final Apprentice quest, promotion to Journeyman. PREREQUISITE FIX: the value in `prerequisites` was a FLAG name, not a quest id - QuestManager reads that list as completed QUEST ids, so this quest was never available and the ladder was dead from mage_02 down. Moved to `flag_prerequisites`, which is the list of flags that is actually checked; the flag itself is raised by the previous quest's on_complete_flags.
